name: openai-mcp-server
purpose: Query OpenAI models (GPT-5.x, o-series) from any MCP client
description: Community OpenAI MCP server: chat completions with tool/function calling against the OpenAI API. The former official openai/mcp repo was retired; this npm package is the current installable server.
connect_steps: 1. Set OPENAI_API_KEY in ~/.hermes/.env
2. echo Y | hermes --accept-hooks mcp add openai --command npx --args -y openai-mcp-server --env OPENAI_API_KEY=${env:OPENAI_API_KEY}
3. hermes mcp list to confirm, then /reload-mcp

name: groq-mcp

description: Official Groq MCP server (groq/groq-mcp-server). Exposes GroqCloud's fast inference models with function calling; requires a free Groq API key.
connect_steps: 1. Get free key at console.groq.com; add GROQ_API_KEY to ~/.hermes/.env
2. echo Y | hermes --accept-hooks mcp add groq --command uvx --args groq-mcp --env GROQ_API_KEY=${env:GROQ_API_KEY}
3. hermes mcp list; restart or /reload-mcp

name: ollama-mcp

connect_steps: 1. Install & run Ollama locally (ollama serve) and pull a model
2. echo Y | hermes --accept-hooks mcp add ollama --command npx --args -y ollama-mcp
3. hermes mcp list; restart or /reload-mcp

name: lmstudio-mcp
purpose: Use local LM Studio models (any GGUF) as an MCP tool backend
description: LMStudio-MCP (infinitimeless) bridges Claude/other MCP clients to locally running LM Studio models via its OpenAI-compatible endpoint. Local-first, free, no API key.
install_command: pip install requests "mcp[cli]" openai && python lmstudio_bridge.py
connect_steps: 1. Run LM Studio with a model loaded and server on localhost:1234
2. pip install requests 'mcp[cli]' openai in the server venv
3. Add server: command=python, args=['lmstudio_bridge.py'] in config.yaml mcp_servers; hermes mcp list
